note: NGPC state rec area on two sandpit lakes (about 18 and 30 acres) 4 mi E of Alexandria. The camping loops wind through shade trees north of the east lake, set back 70-100 m from the water behind a marshy edge. Modern restrooms, playground; camp host Apr-Oct. Self-pay at the Iron Ranger (cash/check). --Claude
summary: Booking confirmed first-come only (grid: no reservation mark; not on RA). Phone 402-729-5777 confirmed (grid). Not waterfront confirmed: loops sit 70-100 m back from the east lake behind marsh and trees. Lakes ~18 and ~30 acres (over the pond line). Pin at the entrance off the county road, ~150 m from the loop centre (OK). Site count 53 / 50 A / dump unverified (outdoornebraska.gov blocked).
flags: WATERFRONT not waterfront confirmed (no change): on NAIP the campground roads and sites lie in the trees north of the east lake, 70-100 m from open water, with a band of marsh/cattail and trees along the lake's north edge; the camp road sits between most sites and the shore. The lakes are well over the 5-acre pond line (NAIP NIR flood fill: east lake ~18.5 acres, west lake ~30 acres). Nothing earns an on-water value; a filtered lakeview from a few sites can't be shown without campsite photos.
SAND RULE passes: gravel camp roads in a wooded area; no beach camping.

WEBSITE: the second line, visitnebraska.com, is a tourism directory listing; the operator's page https://outdoornebraska.gov/location/alexandria/ is already the first line. Suggest dropping the visitnebraska line (by hand; apply.py does not write website).
